*   [Purely Functional Data Structures](https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~rwh/students/okasaki.pdf) - Chris Okasaki (PDF)
*   [Text Algorithms](http://igm.univ-mlv.fr/~mac/REC/text-algorithms.pdf) - Maxime Crochemore, Wojciech Rytter (PDF)
